description: This is a React component for a projects management page, including listing, searching, creating, editing, and deleting projects with CRUD operations and pagination.

methods.name: paginate(items, page, pageSize)
methods.description: Utility function to paginate an array of items into pages.

methods.name: ProjectsPage()
methods.description: Main React component rendering the projects management page with list, search, create, edit, delete, and pagination functionalities.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of projects from the API and updates the state.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Opens the modal dialog to create a new project.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Opens the modal dialog to edit an existing project.

methods.name: closeModal
methods.description: Closes the project create/edit modal dialog.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving a new or edited project, updates state optimistically, and syncs with backend.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a project with optimistic UI update and error handling.
